newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: FIRE SWEEPS CZECH PARLIAMENT ANNEX.
newsitem.headline: FIRE SWEEPS CZECH PARLIAMENT ANNEX.

text.p: Fire broke out in an annex to the Czech parliament in a historic part of central Prague early on Thursday, injuring one fireman, the fire brigade said.

No details of the firman's injuries were not immediately available. One other received minor treatment after the blaze swept part of a building in the same the street as the baroque parliament itself, said Vaclav Hladik, chief investigator for the Prague fire brigade.
The building, a former Jesuit monastery, was under reconstruction and had not yet been occupied. It was empty when the blaze broke out in the early hours.
By morning the fire had been brought under control. "We cannot estimate the cost of the damage yet, nor do we know the cause," Hladik told Reuters.
